name: clearlink-pdf
description: Deterministic PDF cleanup and transformation workflows for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Clean, transform, inspect, and batch-process PDF files locally
interface.longDescription: Use ClearLink PDF for deterministic PDF workflows including link and annotation removal, compression, text and image extraction, merging, splitting, rotation, encryption, decryption, watermarking, metadata scrubbing, and PDF-to-image conversion. Prefer the bundled local processing scripts and verify outputs after every write operation.
defaultPrompt: Remove all links and metadata from this PDF.
Merge these PDFs and verify the output.
Extract the text and images from this PDF.
